FEINN-EUC.timer_normalization: C2 packet_and_model_setup includes the first original H division constructing f. Raw timer retained as a nonadditive diagnostic.

from_zero_rule: Common preparation is observed first E1 FE workflow minus exclusive Gram assembly, conservatively retaining interface/output overhead. DUAL and FREE charge assembly and fresh factor independently. This attribution is not added to actual research wall. ABI/install/smoke/gradient and reference are separate research expenses. Not a fresh cold-system benchmark.
auxiliary_metadata_and_render_operations: Non-numerical reads/Git/doc generation separately identified; no unbounded or parallel numerical runs.
nonnumeric_git_http_and_document_generat: small metadata/network work outside sampled subreaper ledger; no PDE/training; not a benchmark wall claim
